critical_issues: OOD-B structural generalization evaluation is contaminated: 240 of the 360 simulations of 5S_T120 were present in the training partition because the partition was split strictly by earthquake (RSN0001-08) rather than by structural archetype. The claimed 6.97% median error evaluates training data. The true error on unseen test earthquakes is 18.69%.
minor_issues: Training config yaml records learning_rate: 0.005, whereas actual training executed with initial lr: 0.003 as verified in history.csv and pipeline script defaults.

Zero-padding 3-story buildings onto a 5-story grid introduces high-frequency spectral Gibbs phenomena, resulting in 99.60% median relative L2 error on 3-story frames compared to 19.29% on 5-story frames.
unverified_claims: Claim that OOD-B represents an unseen structural archetype during training (5S_T120 was trained on 240 samples across RSN0001-08).
Claim that the current FNO2d surrogate is ready for life-safety engineering deployment without hybrid physics solvers or boundary fixes.
scientific_limitations: FNO2d global Fourier kernels struggle with zero-padded boundaries when handling variable floor counts on a fixed grid (3-story vs 5-story).
Severe post-yield bilinear hysteretic cycles exhibit accumulated plastic phase drift under high PGA (>= 0.8g), increasing peak displacement errors.
recommendation: Accept EXP4 with documented caveats regarding OOD-B structure contamination and 3-story zero-padding limits. EXP5 is ready to proceed to address variable structural topologies via Graph Neural Operators (GNO/GNN) and fiber-section representations.
